guides.definition: Creates an observable and applies map and filter operators before subscribing. Requires RxJS in the active TypeScript/Node.js project; Hypershell does not install it.

parameters.name: mapping
parameters.description: Expression returned for each source value.

parameters.name: predicate
parameters.description: Boolean expression deciding which mapped values continue.

examples.title: Double and keep large values
examples.explanation: pipe composes operators without mutating the source observable; subscribe starts this cold sequence.

guides.definition: Debounces input, removes duplicates, and cancels stale asynchronous searches. Requires RxJS in the active TypeScript/Node.js project; Hypershell does not install it.

parameters.name: queryStream
parameters.description: Observable that emits user-entered query strings.

parameters.name: milliseconds
parameters.description: Quiet period before a query continues.

parameters.name: searchFunction
parameters.description: Function returning an observable for one query.

examples.title: Build a type-ahead result stream
examples.explanation: switchMap unsubscribes from the prior inner observable when a newer query arrives, preventing stale results from winning.

guides.definition: Combines the most recent values from two observables into a typed projection. Requires RxJS in the active TypeScript/Node.js project; Hypershell does not install it.

parameters.name: projection
parameters.description: Expression returned for the latest value pair.

examples.title: Build a filtered view model
examples.explanation: combineLatest waits until every source has emitted once, then recomputes the projection whenever either source changes.
